MAGIKARP_KANTONIAN.author: Dee Kariyawasam
MAGIKARP_KANTONIAN.text: This vicious fish POKéMON thrives in the depths warmed by CINNABAR magma. Having achieved dragonhood, it needs no evolution.

FEEBAS_KANTONIAN.author: Dee Kariyawasam
FEEBAS_KANTONIAN.text: This vicious fish POKéMON hides in the cold currents around SEAFOAM ISLANDS. Having achieved dragonhood, it needs no evolution.

OMATO.author: Dee Kariyawasam
OMATO.text: A HELIX shell shelters a pale body restored from DART fragments. It probes cracks with its antennae, retreating at the slightest tremor.
OMATO.provenance_note: User revision of the existing assisted description, changing limbs to antennae; not an independently rewritten entry.

OMATOPS.author: Dee Kariyawasam
OMATOPS.text: It spins on its pointed shell, sweeping small scythes around its body. They pry its prey from rocks for it to eat.
OMATOPS.provenance_note: User revision of the existing assisted description, replacing shellfish with its prey; not an independently rewritten entry.

KABUSTAR.author: Dee Kariyawasam
KABUSTAR.text: A DOME shell covers a blue body restored from HASTE fragments. Soft limbs grip rocks as waves break over its shell.
KABUSTAR.provenance_note: User revision of the existing assisted description, removing wet before rocks; not an independently rewritten entry.

KABUKNIGHT.author: Dee Kariyawasam
KABUKNIGHT.text: Its shell shields a soft blue body. It stands upright with its rear limbs, using its hardened front toward any approaching threat.
KABUKNIGHT.provenance_note: User revision of the existing assisted description; retains some earlier wording.

AMUNYTE.author: Dee Kariyawasam
AMUNYTE.text: Long thought extinct, it survives in flooded caves. Venom seeps from the seams in its shell, keeping predators away from it.
AMUNYTE.provenance_note: User revision of the existing assisted description; retains some earlier wording.

KINKABUTO.author: Dee Kariyawasam
KINKABUTO.text: It waits beneath the soil with its blades folded beside its shell. This ancient hunter strikes when prey stirs the water.
KINKABUTO.provenance_note: User revision of the existing assisted description, replacing silt with soil; retains earlier wording.

AEROPTERYX.author: Dee Kariyawasam
AEROPTERYX.text: It leaps from cliffs on folded wings. Warm air lifts this ancient dragon aloft. It returns to rock ledges when the air cools.
AEROPTERYX.provenance_note: User revision of the existing assisted description, replacing vaults with leaps; retains earlier wording.

OSSCYTHE.author: Dee Kariyawasam
OSSCYTHE.text: Grief binds it to resting places. It sharpens its scythe-like bone tool on stone and stands watch after mourners have left.
OSSCYTHE.provenance_note: User revision of the existing assisted description; retains some earlier wording.

MIME_SR.author: Dee Kariyawasam
MIME_SR.text: It shelters its young behind invisible walls shaped with small gestures. Even at rest, one hand guards the entrance.
MIME_SR.provenance_note: User revision of the existing assisted description, replacing young mimes with its young; retains earlier wording.
